title: The SECRET WEAPON To Closing More Business Deals
description:
Most deals don’t die because of money—they die because of people.

As a deal attorney, I’ve watched countless business sales collapse over miscommunication, “gotcha” lawyering, and pure stubbornness. But there’s one secret weapon that consistently saves deals and gets them across the finish line: empathy.

In this video, I’ll show you how practicing empathy—yes, empathy—can help you:
✔️ Avoid wasting thousands on a deal that will never close
✔️ Keep negotiations collaborative instead of combative
✔️ Understand the seller’s legacy concerns and the buyer’s risks
✔️ Reframe lawyer drama and contract edits without derailing the deal
✔️ Build trust that keeps clients, employees, and lenders on board

Whether you’re buying your first accounting practice, selling your life’s work, or just want better deal-making skills, empathy isn’t “soft.” It’s the sharpest tool you have to actually close.
